note: Reader-facing glossary for subsite margin definitions. One entry per term. atlas/GLOSSARY.md remains the atlas jurisdiction glossary and is not this file.

terms.definition: The name of this subsite. It spans the Niagara area across New York and Ontario. It is not Niagara Region, the Ontario upper-tier municipality.
The official upper-tier municipality of twelve lower-tier municipalities in Ontario. Not a name for the wider Niagara area, and not the name of this subsite.
A point where trends, characteristics, place assets, and pools of capital coincide so as to enable action, investment, and growth.
A lens over shared place data: a set of regions, an optional topic selection, and a landing page.
